text:
**Short answer:** no single product I found charges a laptop, phone and watch with a built-in watch pad. The best options are one hub that covers all three with an extra cable, or a two-piece setup.

## Option 1: One unit (Baseus Nomos 5-in-1, 140W + Qi2), $149.99
- It has a 140W USB-C port (enough for a 16" MacBook Pro), a retractable 100W cable, a USB-C port, a USB-A port, and a 15W Qi2 pad for the phone. ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-nomos-5-in-1-140w-qi2))
- **No watch pad.** You'd plug your watch's own charging puck into one of the spare ports.
- It was **sold out** on Baseus's US store when checked on 2026-10-21, so check stock first.
- [Buy at Baseus](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-nomos-5-in-1-140w-qi2). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you.

## Option 2: Two pieces (my pick if you have an Apple Watch)
1. **Phone + watch + earbuds:** The [Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) was WIRED's best overall. It charges an iPhone at up to 15W and fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer. It lists at $109 and was about $98 at Belkin, $90 on Amazon and $80 at Best Buy when WIRED last updated prices. If you want something cheaper, WIRED's budget pick is the [ESR Qi2 3-in-1](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) at about $40 (down from $80).
2. **Laptop:** The Anker 341 USB-C Hub (about $40) passes through up to 100W to a laptop and adds HDMI, an SD card slot and extra ports. ([StandDeskLab](https://standdesklab.com/accessories/best-desk-charging-station/)) I only have the review page for this one, not a direct product link, so search the name on Amazon or Anker.

## Before you buy
- **Match the wattage to your laptop.** A MacBook Air needs about 30–35W, a 14" MacBook Pro about 70W, and a 16" MacBook Pro about 140W. ([The Office Journal](https://www.theofficejournal.com/guide/best-charging-stations-for-multiple-devices-desk)) A 100W hub won't charge a 16" Pro at full speed, but the Baseus 140W port will.
- **Check the watch compatibility.** These 3-in-1 stands are built for Apple Watch. If you have a Galaxy Watch or Pixel Watch, you'd need a different pad, and I can look for one.
- **Prices vary between sources.** Anker's 3-in-1 was listed at $89.99 by one site and about $100 (often discounted to $35–45) by another, so check the current price.

If you tell me your laptop model and watch brand, I can narrow this to one pick.
